needed_streams: To separate local load change from a zone sensor fault for Zone_F3_Z01, the following would be needed but are not exposed by this building's catalog (which only has Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor, Zone cooling/heating setpoints, and Damper_Position_Setpoint): (1) a local electrical power/thermal load meter for the zone (to confirm a real local load increase); and (2) an independent redundant zone-air temperature sensor in the same zone (to confirm or refute a drifting/faulty sensor). Optional supporting stream: a zone occupancy sensor.

content.text:
All zones shifted up after July 2018 (building-wide), with F3_Z01 among the higher risers. To separate "local load change" from "zone sensor fault" I would need: a local electrical-load/power meter for Zone_F3_Z01 (to confirm a real load increase), and an independent redundant zone-air temperature sensor (to confirm/deny a drifting sensor). The building exposes neither — the catalog contains only zone air temperature sensors, their heating/cooling setpoints, and damper position setpoints (no per-zone power meter, occupancy sensor, or redundant temperature sensor).

So the available data cannot distinguish the two candidate causes.

input.needed_streams: To separate local load change from a zone sensor fault for Zone_F3_Z01, the following would be needed but are not exposed by this building's catalog (which only has Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor, Zone cooling/heating setpoints, and Damper_Position_Setpoint): (1) a local electrical power/thermal load meter for the zone (to confirm a real local load increase); and (2) an independent redundant zone-air temperature sensor in the same zone (to confirm or refute a drifting/faulty sensor). Optional supporting stream: a zone occupancy sensor.
